title: Gaurav Sen launches AI app to detect potholes and file #GauravSen #potholecomplaints #smartcitytech
description: Gaurav Sen developed an app that detects potholes, identifies the responsible contractor, and files a complaint within 4 seconds. Using a dashcam with GPS and an accelerometer, the app records pothole impacts and processes the footage with AI vision models to classify pothole severity. The innovation leverages data from 2,900 government road contracts in India to pinpoint the exact contractor responsible under construction warranties. This enables automated, rapid complaint filing, transforming how road maintenance accountability is managed. This technology presents a scalable solution for improving urban infrastructure by holding contractors accountable, reducing pothole-related issues, and enhancing commuter safety through AI-driven complaint automation. #GauravSen #PotholeDetectionApp #OpenAI #CodexAI #RoadMaintenance #SmartCities #AIForGood #UrbanInfrastructure #ConstructionWarranty #GovernmentContracts #BengaluruTech #AIvision #AutomatedComplaints #InfrastructureInnovation #RoadSafety
